title: The Quran: Surah 1, al-Fatihah (The Opening)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 1. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: What does the speaker ask for in verse 6?
options: To be guided to the straight path
questions.why: O versículo 6 diz: 'Guide us to the straight path.'

options: to show deep respect and devotion
questions.why: 'Worship' é adorar, mostrar profundo respeito e devoção.

questions.q: What does the word 'we' in verses 5 and 6 suggest?
options: The speaker is speaking together with other people
questions.why: 'We' e 'us' mostram que o falante fala em conjunto com outras pessoas, e não só por si.

questions.q: What changes between verses 1 to 4 and verse 5?
options: The text talks about Allah, and then speaks directly to Him with 'You'
The text moves from a question to a command
The text moves from the past to the future
The text moves from one place to another
questions.why: Nos versículos 1 a 4 fala-se Dele; no versículo 5 passa-se a 'It is You we worship'.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up the passage?
options: Praise, followed by a request for guidance
questions.why: Os versículos 1 a 4 são louvor e os versículos 6 e 7 são o pedido de guia.

B2.discussion: The passage begins with praise and ends with a request. Why might a text put praise before a request?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say what the speaker praises and what he asks for.

options: Master of the Day of Judgment
questions.why: O versículo 4 diz: 'Master of the Day of Judgment.'
'Misguided' descreve quem foi mal guiado ou perdeu o caminho certo.

questions.q: Verse 7 names three groups. What does the request in verses 6 and 7 suggest the speaker wants?
options: To follow the path of the first group, not of the other two
questions.why: O texto pede 'the path of those You have blessed, not of those against whom there is anger, nor of those who are misguided'.

questions.q: In verse 7, 'not of those... nor of those...' works as:
options: two exclusions after the path that is asked for
questions.why: 'Not' e 'nor' excluem dois grupos, depois de se nomear o caminho pedido.

questions.q: Which description of the passage's order is best supported?
options: Names and praise (verses 1 to 4), a statement to Him (verse 5), a request (verses 6 and 7)
questions.why: O texto começa com nomes e louvor, passa ao 'You' no versículo 5 e acaba com o pedido.

C1.discussion: The passage shifts from talking about Him to talking to Him. How does this shift change the feel of the text?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verse 7 develops the request made in verse 6.

glossary: those against whom there is anger

questions.q: How does verse 3 relate to verse 1?
options: It repeats the two titles in a stronger form
questions.why: O versículo 1 diz 'the Gracious, the Merciful' e o versículo 3 diz 'The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful'.

questions.q: 'Master of the Day of Judgment' names Him as:
options: the one in control on that Day
questions.why: 'Master of' indica quem tem o domínio, aqui sobre o Dia do Julgamento.

questions.q: What does verse 5, with 'You', do in the middle of the passage?
options: It turns the text from description to direct address and prepares the request
questions.why: Antes dele fala-se Dele; depois do versículo 5 vem o pedido feito directamente.
'We worship' e 'we call for help' são duas acções paralelas ligadas por 'and'.

questions.q: Which statement is best supported by the passage as a whole?
options: It moves from naming and praise, through direct address, to a request that defines the path by contrast
It tells a story in time order
questions.why: O versículo 7 define o caminho por contraste: o caminho dos abençoados, não o dos outros dois grupos.

C2.discussion: The request in verse 7 defines the path by naming those whose path is wanted and those whose path is not. What does defining by contrast add compared with a simple request for the right path?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the seven verses move from praise to request, referring to specific words and to the shift in address.
